title: How long to boil an egg for soft, medium, and hard
summary: A timer that starts when the water boils: six, eight, or eleven minutes to the yolk you want.

blocks.title: Start the clock when the water does
blocks.body: Eggs do not care when you put the pot on. They care how long they spend at a rolling boil. Cover cold eggs with an inch of cold water, bring it to a full boil, and that first big bubble is minute zero.

blocks.heading: Pick a yolk, count from the boil

items.title: Soft
items.detail: White just set, yolk runs. Peel under running water and eat it today - soft eggs do not keep.

items.title: Medium
items.detail: Yolk goes jammy at the edges and stays soft in the middle. The egg-salad and ramen sweet spot.

items.title: Hard
items.detail: Fully set with no green ring. Past twelve minutes the sulfur smell starts and the white goes rubbery.

blocks.title: When the count ends
blocks.body: Off the heat and straight into ice water at the bell - the yolk keeps cooking in a hot shell. Peel from the fat end, where the air pocket lives.
